timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hi, this is Harold Harb and today in lesson two we're going to work on listing one ski and tilting it so that we can get a parallel turn.
Alright, hi skiers. Here we are. This is lesson two of the How to Ski Series, my new series on YouTube.
We're going to talk about the opposite of what you learned when you began to ski because that's the only way you're really going to get to become an advanced skier or an expert skier.
So what you learned at the beginning is this, that is not going to carry you through to become an expert skier.
You're going to have to reverse those movements and they're going to be absolutely different from the way you learned at the beginning.
So the idea here is the sooner you learn how to reverse those movements to make yourself a parallel advanced skier, the faster you're going to progress to become an expert.
So here's how it works.
Pretend my hands are your ski or your feet bottoms. If I'm about to turn in this direction, which for me is to the left.
My first movement will always be with the inside foot, which is this one.
Going that way, that's the inside foot for the arc. That will tilt towards the little toe edge.
My little toe edge is down here on the outside of my foot along the outside of the ski.
So my little toe edge is going to tip just like my hand and my skier tipping in that direction.
So I'm going to slide along and I'm going to tip that foot in that direction.
That's going to make the other ski turn and you want to be passive with this right ski for this turn.
And just allow it to stay flat and the actions of the inside foot, this action will create a turn for both skis.
And I'm going to show you that right now.
So first to practice this, I'm holding myself on the slope of the pole so I don't go downhill.
And I'm going to tilt this foot to its little toe edge and then you'll see the reaction that I get out of my skis.
That was so simple and easy. It almost looks absurd, doesn't it?
Well, it can make you a parallel ski immediately and it can take you along to the advanced skiing level.
Now I'm going to do a few more here for you so you can see how effective that little movement is.
Just start with a straight run to begin with and you're only going to make one turn in one direction at first to get the feel of the energy and the power for parallel skiing with the little toe edge,
Phantom tipping move. Here it is.
